newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela tax body to repay PDVSA $1 billion.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela tax body to repay PDVSA $1 billion.

text.p: Venezuela's tax authority SENIAT will in June start repaying $1.04 billion in debt to state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela, the SENIAT chief said on Friday.
The "drawback" debt comes from an export incentive scheme involving refunds of customs duty, and some private companies are also waiting for their payments.
SENIAT head Moraima Campos said the formula governing the repayment schedule was still being worked out.
"We think we will reimburse the taxes to PDVSA soon, which would be a first," Campos told journalists.
"We are studying the possibility of paying it off over the next few months because we don't want to hit the Treasury's cash flow," she added.
The total debt is equivalent to 1.3 percent of GDP and analysts in Congress say they have contributed to the appearance of fiscal balance in government figures.
